notes: UpdateThreadedAT: the AudioTrack JNI path (NewObject, Play, NewByteArray, Stop, Release through JNIEnv) has no port stand-in, and the DoCallbackAT loop with its usleep is not ported; returns 0

DestroyDriverSource: the source list (sentinel at +0x10, 12-byte nodes) is not a member of the port DriverAndroid, so the unlink is missing; the lock, the virtual destructor call and VoxFree are in the pseudocode
Mode dispatch: mode 1 calls _ShutdownAT, mode 2 calls _ShutdownOSL, others do nothing; matches the pseudocode. The OSL body is its own row

_InitAT: stores the sample rate; the JNI class and method lookup (FindClass, GetMethodID, GetStaticMethodID, GetMinBufferSize) has no JNIEnv in the port, so the ring sizing and pthread_create are missing
Init: lock and unlock only; the calls to DriverCallbackInterface::Init and SetDefaultParameter (base not inherited by DriverAndroid here) and _InitAT are missing
D1: Shutdown only; missing is the DriverCallbackInterface base destructor call, because the port DriverAndroid derives from DriverInterface
D0: compiler-generated deleting destructor around D1; inherits the D1 gap (base destructor)
D2: same body as D1; inherits the base destructor gap
C1: same body as C2; missing is the DriverCallbackInterface base constructor call
C2: mode 0 and Init; missing is the DriverCallbackInterface base constructor call

CreateDriverSource: lock and unlock only; missing are the DriverAndroidSource allocation and constructor (format word at +0x0c), and the source list insertion, which the port DriverAndroid does not have
Update(float): period word at +0x04 moves an eighth of the way to dt*16384 (f2iz, saturating); ARM returns the difference but the void virtual slot never exposes it
GetNbAvailableSamples: ring walk matches the ARM branch by branch. Missing: the __aeabi_idiv result when buffer_bytes_ is zero (the port returns 0, the ARM value depends on the runtime __aeabi_idiv0)

FillBufferStereo16NoInter: the ramp hand-off after a buffer ends mid-block (the ARM LABEL_29/LABEL_30 path that sets the fraction and the ramp value) is transcribed but no test checks it against the asm
_FillBuffer: missing the name of the vtable slot +0x60 on each mixed source (the port does not call a named slot here) and the float return value of the 3D setup helper, which the port drops
FreeDisposableData: the second-pass release walk and its carried sample count (the ARM v32 path) are transcribed; only the zero-request path is tested
GetPitch: __aeabi_i2f of the word at +0x34, then __aeabi_fmul by 0x38800000 (2^-14)
GetGain: __aeabi_i2f of the word at +0x28, then __aeabi_fmul by 0x38800000 (2^-14)

SetGain: gain > 1.0f stores 0x4000, gain < 0.0f stores 0, otherwise f2iz of gain*16384 (NaN gives 0). Earlier port checked == instead of the ARM compares and kept negatives; fixed. Test: w11_driver_callback_gain_update_test
FillBufferStereo16: the interpolating mix from the scratch copy is transcribed; the ramp hand-off between two blocks is not checked by a test
FillBufferMono16NoInter: the per-channel ramp hand-off (the ARM path after the ramp is set) is transcribed but no test checks it
FillBufferMono16: the interpolating mono mix from the scratch copy; the ramp hand-off between two blocks is not checked by a test

Init: the template for each new ring entry has word 0 at sp+0x20, which the function never stores, so the original copies an uninitialised stack word; the port writes 0. Everything else (gains, rate ratio, pitch defaults, ring growth) is ported
GetCurThreadId: the ARM returns pthread_self; no portable pthread_t value exists on Windows, so the port returns a hash of std::thread::id

VoxThread C1: name, callback and thread start ported. Missing: the priority step, which is determined (max if max <= 30, else max(min, 31)) but needs pthread_setschedparam, which std::thread cannot do
VoxThread C2: same body as C1; missing is the pthread_setschedparam priority step

CloseFile: missing is the value of FileInterface vtable slot +0x18 (not declared in the port). The ARM passes that value to m_IOFunc+0x14 (g_file_close) when nonzero; the port passes GetFilePtr() instead, which matches only if slot +0x18 returns the handle
Tail call to ftell; returns the position (long)
Tail call to fwrite; returns the count (size_t)
Tail call to fread; returns the count (size_t)

Copies three words to the object field at +0x24..+0x2c. Ghidra index puts the body at elf 0x890364 (no IDA listing); the owning class and its caller are not identified, so the field is passed in. Test: w9_fun_copy_slot24_test
